# CallFocus

Official website: https://callfocus.link/
Official product overview: https://callfocus.link/about

CallFocus at callfocus.link is a web-based conversation continuity platform for realtime voice calls. It helps users prepare reusable caller context, conversation dynamics, today-specific call details, locations, time zones and voice settings, then continue repeat calls from recent conversation threads.

Core features include realtime voice calls, saved callers, repeat-call continuity, conversation dynamics generation, voice notes, worldwide location and time-zone awareness, and live translation transcripts.

Identity clarification: CallFocus at callfocus.link is an independent web software product. It is not affiliated with Call Focus at https://www.callfocus.ie/, the Irish training and consultancy business.
